# partiteai_memory_interaction_profile (Resource)

A memory interaction profile: what an agent is given from memory, and what it can call to read or write more. An agent can hold several, and a profile does nothing until the agent runs in a mesh that has a memory store.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Resource name

### Optional

- `allow_expansion` (Boolean) Let the agent read around a record it was given: the quotes either side of a quote, the quote a fact came from, the facts behind an observation
- `context_injections` (Attributes List) What goes in the agent's prompt from memory, without the agent asking for it (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context_injections))
- `conversation_history` (Attributes) Put what was said in this conversation in the agent's prompt (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conversation_history))
- `description` (String) Resource description
- `query_tools` (Attributes List) The tools this agent can call to search memory (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query_tools))
- `write_tools` (Attributes List) The tools this agent can call to write a memory (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--write_tools))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--context_injections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context_injections`

Required:

- `name` (String) Identifies this injection to a person. It is not put in the prompt.
- `query` (Attributes) What this injection searches memory for (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context_injections--query))
- `record_types` (List of String) The kinds of record to read: CHUNK for what was said, FACT for a claim taken out of it, OBSERVATION for a summary of facts. At least one is required.
- `selection` (Attributes) Which memories this reads. ALL reads every record of the store. TAGS reads the records that carry the tags below. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context_injections--selection))
- `token_budget` (Number) How many tokens of memory this injection can hold

Optional:

- `description` (String) What these memories are, written at the head of the section that holds them

<a id="nestedatt--context_injections--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context_injections.query`

Required:

- `kind` (String) FIXED searches for the text below. DERIVED searches for what the agent was given to work on.

Optional:

- `text` (String) What FIXED searches for. Required for FIXED, and DERIVED does not read it.


<a id="nestedatt--context_injections--selection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context_injections.selection`

Required:

- `kind` (String) ALL or TAGS

Optional:

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags to read by. At least one is required for TAGS, and ALL takes none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context_injections--selection--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--context_injections--selection--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context_injections.selection.tags`

Required:

- `source` (String) FIXED reads by the value below. REQUEST_TAG reads by whatever the request carries under request_tag_key.
- `tag_key` (String) The key this reads the store by

Optional:

- `request_tag_key` (String) The key to read off the request. Required for REQUEST_TAG.
- `tag_value` (String) The value FIXED reads by. Required for FIXED.




<a id="nestedatt--conversation_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conversation_history`

Required:

- `token_budget` (Number) How many tokens of history the prompt can hold

Optional:

- `query` (Attributes) What a RELEVANT selection searches for. A RECENT selection does not read it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conversation_history--query))
- `selection` (String) RECENT takes an unbroken run of turns ending at the newest one. RELEVANT searches the conversation for what the query is about.

<a id="nestedatt--conversation_history--query"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conversation_history.query`

Required:

- `kind` (String) FIXED searches for the text below. DERIVED searches for what the agent was given to work on.

Optional:

- `text` (String) What FIXED searches for. Required for FIXED, and DERIVED does not read it.



<a id="nestedatt--query_tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query_tools`

Required:

- `description` (String) What the tool is for, and when to call it
- `record_types` (List of String) The kinds of record to read: CHUNK for what was said, FACT for a claim taken out of it, OBSERVATION for a summary of facts. At least one is required.
- `selection` (Attributes) Which memories this reads. ALL reads every record of the store. TAGS reads the records that carry the tags below. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query_tools--selection))
- `tool_name` (String) What the agent calls. A model tells two tools apart by name, so it has to be unique across the profiles one agent holds.

Optional:

- `effort_levels` (Attributes List) The amounts the agent can ask for by name. Give either this or token_budget. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query_tools--effort_levels))
- `token_budget` (Number) How many tokens one call returns. Give either this or effort_levels.

<a id="nestedatt--query_tools--selection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query_tools.selection`

Required:

- `kind` (String) ALL or TAGS

Optional:

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags to read by. At least one is required for TAGS, and ALL takes none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--query_tools--selection--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--query_tools--selection--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query_tools.selection.tags`

Required:

- `source` (String) FIXED reads by the value below. REQUEST_TAG reads by whatever the request carries under request_tag_key.
- `tag_key` (String) The key this reads the store by

Optional:

- `request_tag_key` (String) The key to read off the request. Required for REQUEST_TAG.
- `tag_value` (String) The value FIXED reads by. Required for FIXED.



<a id="nestedatt--query_tools--effort_levels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `query_tools.effort_levels`

Required:

- `level` (String) What the model names this amount, such as "quick" or "deep"
- `token_budget` (Number) How many tokens a call at this level returns



<a id="nestedatt--write_tools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `write_tools`

Required:

- `description` (String) What the tool is for, and when to call it
- `tool_name` (String) What the agent calls

Optional:

- `tag_mappings` (Attributes List) The tags to put on what this tool writes. They apply in order, and a later one replaces the value an earlier one wrote under the same key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--write_tools--tag_mappings))

<a id="nestedatt--write_tools--tag_mappings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `write_tools.tag_mappings`

Required:

- `kind` (String) FIXED writes the one tag below. ALL_FROM_REQUEST copies every tag of the request. KEYS_FROM_REQUEST copies the keys named below.

Optional:

- `keys` (List of String) The request tag keys to copy. At least one is required for KEYS_FROM_REQUEST.
- `tag_key` (String) The key FIXED writes. Required for FIXED.
- `tag_value` (String) The value FIXED writes. Required for FIXED.
